card.name: Digits inside numbers in data tables
card.fires_on: Spaces, decimal points and digits within numbers in tables of results, such as confidence intervals and patient counts. Also the space before a day number after a month name.

modes.label: Numbers in intervals
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a number in a confidence interval or percent range.

modes.description: A digit in a patient count or fraction, or the space before a count.
